user_statement:

journal_first_basis: Maintainer reports case-specific arXiv advice to submit to JOSS or another journal first; not a claim about universal arXiv policy.
interpretation: Personal confirmations are recorded without re-requesting assent. Agreement to human-written communication is a commitment, not authorship of the existing AI-assisted draft. Survey completion remains an external action needing a completion fact. Priority change authorizes withdrawal of the two identified earlier requests, not a claim of editorial approval.
